summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Food Ops Module enhancements. All new features are working correctly: Value by Category dashboard, Price History dialog, Supplier fields (Primary/Secondary, Payment Terms, Credit Limit), Portion Format dialog with margin-based pricing, Allergens persistence, and Print PO functionality.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Food Ops enhancements verified: 1) Value by Category shows inventory totals by type (Food, Packaging, Disposable, Equipment, Event Supply), 2) Price History dialog shows price changes for inventory items, 3) Edit Item dialog has Primary/Secondary Supplier and Purchase Info fields, 4) Edit Supplier dialog has Payment Terms (method dropdown) and Credit Limit fields, 5) Recipe Costing tab has Add Format dialog with margin-based pricing (Cost per Portion, Target Margin %, auto-calculated Sell Price, Gross Margin summary), 6) Recipe Details tab has Allergens checkboxes that persist on save, 7) Purchase Orders have Print icon that opens print dialog with PO details.

value_by_category.details: Shows 5 category cards (Food, Packaging, Disposable, Equipment, Event Supply) with item counts and total values

price_history.details: History icon opens dialog showing current price and price change history

inventory_suppliers.details: Edit Item dialog shows Primary Supplier, Secondary Supplier, Purchase Unit, Pack Size fields

supplier_payment_terms.details: Edit Supplier dialog shows Payment Method dropdown (Cash/Transfer/Credit/Mixed) and Credit Limit field

portion_formats.details: Add Format dialog shows Cost per Portion (calculated), Target Margin %, Sell Price (auto-calculated), Gross Margin summary

allergens_persistence.details: 14 allergen checkboxes available, selected allergens persist after save and reopen

print_po.details: Print icon visible on PO rows, opens print dialog with company name, PO details, items table, and Print button
